```sql
WITH region_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'San Luis Obispo County'
    AND border_type = 'county'
),
longest_road AS (
  SELECT r.id, r.geometry, r.road_name
  FROM roads r
  JOIN region_geom rg ON ST_Intersects(r.geometry, rg.geometry)
  WHERE r.highway IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY ST_Length(r.geometry::geometry) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
raster_slope AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Slope(
      ST_Clip(public.dem_us.rast, longest_road.geometry::geometry),
      1
    ) AS slope_rast
  FROM longest_road, public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(public.dem_us.rast, longest_road.geometry::geometry)
),
slope_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Stats(slope_rast, 1, TRUE) AS stats
  FROM raster_slope
)
SELECT 
  longest_road.road_name AS road_name,
  stats.mean AS average_slope
FROM longest_road, slope_stats;
```
